newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta shares drop despite active secondaries.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta shares drop despite active secondaries.

text.p: Jakarta shares price ended lower on Monday despite active trading in secondary stocks after sustained profit taking in many counters, brokers said.

The Jakarta Composite Index fell 0.84 points, or 0.14 percent, to close at 623.61 points after touching an intra-day low of 621.83 points earlier. Decliners led gainers by 52 to 46, with 59 counters unchanged.
Brokers said the market was likely to be mixed on Tuesday as there remained a lack of fresh leads with some players trading on a speculative basis.

"I expect the result of the U.S. Federal Reserve meeting tonight will give a fresh lead to the market on Tuesday but it will not be big because the market itself has already slowed down" a broker with foreign firm said.
Brokers said overall market sentiment was mixed with some counters attracting attention for speculative reasons.
Retail and information technology firm Multipolar topped the active list with 20.4 million shares changing hands. It rose 150 rupiah to 1,225 rupiah on market talk of a stock split this year.
Brokers said the active trading was also linked to recent news that the company would increase its working capital by using the proceeds from a previous right issue.
Property firm Modern Land rose 225 rupiah to 1,450 rupiah on a volume of 9.3 million shares on what brokers said was speculative buying following year-end window dressing.
Banking stocks including Bank Negara Indonesia (BNI), Bank International Indonesia and Bank Umum Servitia were among the target of profit-takers, brokers said.
BNI fell 25 rupiah to 1,275 rupiah on a volume of 6.9 million shares.
Heavyweight Telkom was also actively traded at an unchanged price of 3,950 rupiah with 2.2 million shares changing hands.

Monday's new listing, snack-food producer Siantar Top, was actively traded with a volume of 8.6 million shares, rising to 2,350 rupiah, or 6.8 percent higher than its offer price of 2,200 rupiah. It earlier touched a peak of 2,400 rupiah.
